C1833.title: Buyer Faked Durian Mold Photos for "Refund-Only" Fraud; Merchant Drove 1,600 km to Defend Rights
C1833.summary: In June 2026, Guangming Daily reported that the "refund-only" rule was being abused by some buyers for profit. In a typical case, a buyer faked photos of moldy durian flesh to submit false feedback and claim a refund-only, forcing merchant Mr. Cheng to drive 1,600 km at his own expense of over 5,000 yuan to defend his rights. Police confirmed the buyer had fabricated evidence, and the platform later coordinated to return the payment to the merchant. The case reflects the real risk of "refund-only" mechanisms being exploited as wool-pulling and malicious-refund tools.

references.title: "Refund-only" becomes a wool-pulling tool: how to balance merchant and buyer interests - Guangming Daily
